source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 <verse ...>...</verse> substring, including markup, whitespace, written forms, and any reading notes. No XML reserialization or Hebrew normalization.

key_decisions.decision: Retain sons of God without identifying them as angels or kings in the main text; keep unilateral choosing and source-described beauty.
Retain remain with contend/judge alternatives and the disputed scope of 120 years in the note.
Keep Nephilim untranslated and the temporal clauses intact; do not supply a speculative identity or genealogy beyond the statement.
Retain regret and grief as the divine response rather than replacing them with an explanation that denies the wording.
Preserve all flesh, the causal violence claim, and the scope of destruction; note destroy as another use of the corrupt root.
Keep the unidentified timber name and explain ark/compartments/pitch selectively; do not assert a wood species.
Choose roof for the uncertain tsohar construction with alternatives noted; retain cubit, side entrance, and three levels without claiming a complete blueprint.
